snippet.title: Million x Pac-Man (HTML5) - Gameplay Video
snippet.description:
Million x Pac-Man is a 2019 promotional webgame for Paco Rabanne's Million brand of men's cologne, as part of an official collaboration with Bandai Namco. Cabinets and kiosks of the game were also built for certain stores. The idea for the campaign is to challenge people to score 1 million points, which would grant them an entry to the "hall of fame."

The game itself looks like the typical arcade maze fare at first. However, the maze cannot be completed. Dots spawn back in gradually. And as the player progresses, they can use randomized items to help add to their score or movement over Pac-Man. Not all items are good, though, as some may spawn additional obstacles temporarily.
